specs.Item Type Name: Mag-Safe 10000Mah Wireless Power Bank with Stand

features: Strong Mag-Safe Magnetic Wireless Charging – Built-in powerful magnets snap perfectly to iPhone 17/16/15/14/13/12 series for stable, secure & aligned wireless charging without cable hassle.
20W Fast Wired Output – High-speed 20W wired charging via USB Type-C port for quick power delivery to smartphones and other devices.
10000mAh High-Capacity Battery – Charge your smartphone multiple times with this compact yet powerful 10000mAh power bank, perfect for travel, office & daily use.
Built-in Foldable Stand – Hands-free viewing while charging. Ideal for video calls, movies, reels & gaming—both portrait and landscape mode supported.
Universal Compatibility – Compatible with iPhone 17/16/15/14/13/12 Series, Android phones, Samsung, OnePlus, Pixel & all Qi-enabled devices.
description: KARWAN Mag-Safe 10000mAh Wireless Power Bank with Stand is designed for fast, convenient and reliable charging on the go. Equipped with 15W Mag-Safe wireless charging and 20W PD wired fast charging, this power bank delivers efficient power to your devices without interruptions. The strong magnetic attachment ensures perfect alignment with iPhone 17/16/15/14/13/12 series for seamless wireless charging, while the USB-C port supports high-speed wired charging for Android smartphones and other devices. With a high-capacity 10000mAh battery, you can easily charge your phone multiple times during travel, work or emergencies. Its built-in foldable stand allows hands-free viewing while charging—perfect for watching videos, attending video calls, or gaming. Designed with a slim, lightweight and premium finish, the KARWAN Mag-Safe Power Bank fits effortlessly into your lifestyle. Compatible with Qi-enabled Android devices, Samsung, OnePlus, Pixel and more, this power bank is a must-have accessory for fast, safe and smart charging.
